packet: V2-QUAL-ORACLE-DIRECT (V1 acceptance #6 exact narrow Over correctness, #9 unsupported fallback safe)

expected_cases.persistent_formula: 6 sizes x 6 alphas x 6 sources x 6 destinations + offset + clip

predicates.correctness: every phase: fail == 0 and maxd == 0 (exact RGB, no tolerance) and the oracle prints RESULT PASS
predicates.case_counts: each PHASE_RESULT cases equals expected_cases for that phase
predicates.direct_attribution: GATEA_EVENT event=5 (LEASE_GPU_OWNED) inside [MARK persistent BEGIN, MARK persistent END] == persistent cases; requires the event stream complete
predicates.negative_no_direct: event=5 inside the negative phase window == 0
predicates.fresh_direct: reported, not required (fresh pairs churn registration; admission may legally fall to staging)
predicates.lifecycle: close summary: c12==c13, c14==c15, c16==c17, c18==c19==c20==0, c21..c24==0, c27==1, generationFatal==0, firstFailed==0
predicates.no_fatal: zero Fatal signal / GATEA_FATAL_HALT / tombstone lines naming X or the Activity
predicates.x_survives: X alive until terminate; Activity pid constant through the close
predicates.environment: X3 TracerPid 0; screen Awake and unlocked before and after; Stable :1 before == after

verdict.FAIL_CORRECTNESS: any exact-RGB mismatch, a composite error, or a lifecycle / fatal predicate false; also any event=5 inside the negative window (an op outside the Over a8r8g8b8->x8r8g8b8 slice took a direct GPU lease: #9 breached)
verdict.FAIL_ATTRIBUTION: correct pixels, but fewer persistent cases took the direct path than cases run - the direct path is not proven for all of them
verdict.INVALID: environment or capture predicate false, the event stream incomplete, or case counts wrong (the fixture did not run as frozen); also any correctness or attribution check that could not be evaluated
